subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT the Indian research station in Antarctica?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himalaya**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maitri**, **Bharati**, and **Dakshin Gangotri** are the three Indian research stations in Antarctica.
 
• **Maitri** was commissioned in 1989 and is located in Queen Maud Land.
 
• **Bharati** was commissioned in 2012 and is located in Larsmann Hill.
 
• **Dakshin Gangotri** was the first Indian research station in Antarctica, established in 1983, but now it is used only as a supply base.
 
• **Himalaya** is not an Indian research station in Antarctica; it is a mountain range in Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India's Antarctic program is managed by the National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR), under the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
 
• The objective of the Indian Antarctic program is to conduct scientific research and surveys in various disciplines such as geology, oceanography, and meteorology.
 
• India is a signatory to the Antarctic Treaty System, which regulates international relations with respect to Antarctica to ensure that it is used for peaceful purposes and scientific research.
